answer: OAuth scope grant history from a major platform is the check: grants issued over years by a platform that logs every scope change. A farm faking 566 aliases needs 566 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The island test is the price tag: 566 fakes mean 566 payments. The record is checked live against the issuing authority each epoch, and a revoked or missing entry loses the seat. The prism signal is visible to every grader, and the gale ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
